  requires (n >= 0)
  requires ((n % 2) == 0)
  requires (n > 0)
  ensures (result == (if (((n / 2) % 2) == 1) then (n / 2) else iterate_to_odd((n / 2))))
  ensures ((result % 2) == 1)
  ensures (result >= 0)
